summary.description: Where the run's time and money went, in three sentences at most.

painPoints.description: Each thing to change, ordered by what it cost - the most first; empty where the report shows nothing a change would have paid for.

title.description: One line a person who never saw the run understands: what to change, and where.

severity.description: How much it matters: critical, high, medium or low, as a review grades its findings.

where.description: The steps it names, each by the id of its row in the report's steps - its instance id; a step the report's steps do not hold is refused and you are asked again.

evidence.description: The report's own values it rests on, each a citation: the section, the row by its id, the member and the value exactly as the report holds it. A citation the report does not hold is refused and you are asked again.

section.description: The report's section that holds it.

row.description: The id of the row that holds it, as the row's own id member says it - a step's and a critical path link's its instance, a failed attempt's <instance>@<attempt>, a signal's <kind>#<n>, a question's its id, a dollars group's its name, a convergence row's its id; empty where the member sits in the section itself (theRun, totals).

of.description: The member of the row that holds it, a path of members joined by '.' where it is inside one: seconds, usd, tokens.input, budget.usd.

said.description: The value as the report holds it: a number as the report writes it (30, 0.03) - read for its value - a text word for word.

impact.description: The time and dollars it cost: every number written here is the value of one of this point's citations, in the unit the report holds the cited member in - written bare as the citation holds it, or joined to its unit (3600s, 1.5h, 12k tokens, $0.02, 28%) and converted exactly into the cited member's unit (1.5h for a budget of 90 minutes, never 60 hours for a wait of 60 seconds); numbers joined to units of one kind from the largest to the smallest (1h 30m, 2 min 5 s) are one value, their sum. A number of a kind no member of the report is (2x, a size, another currency - by its sign, its ISO 4217 code or its name: €0.02, R$0.02, 0.02 EUR, 0.02 euros), a number none of them holds, or a word that reads as no one number (a date, a range), is refused and you are asked again - whatever wraps it or joins it to a word: Markdown, a sign, a dash, =, :, +, @, #, a slash; a word is read whole, as an id, only where the report holds it as one (a row's id or a name it is made of, a section's or a member's name) or one of your citations writes it as its path, and hyphens, points and underscores keep a word whole (windows-2022, net10.0). Markdown's marks between a number and its unit change nothing (**1.5** hours); a currency named anywhere in a number's own phrase is its currency (0.02 in euros, 0.02 (EUR), EUR: 0.02, 0.02 Canadian dollars); a minus before a currency's sign is the number's (-$0.02); and a currency's code glued to a digit starts the number (USD0.40, EUR0.40).

cause.description: What the records show of why: no guessing - where the cause is not in the report or the records, it goes under noted instead.

recommendation.description: The change to make: a configuration key, a workflow step's key, a prompt's line or a repository fix - the exact text where it is a key, as the configuration or the yml spells it.

noted.description: What you saw and could not confirm, each with why; empty where you confirmed everything you said.

why.description: Why you could not confirm it from the report or the run's records.
